name: I Dare You to Undress Rhoden
source:
After a day of hunting in the woods, Rhoden challenges you to play “find the 5 differences” with him. 

Each time you find all the differences in each of his personal daguerreotypes, you will be able to remove a piece of his clothing!

Get Rhoden naked before you lose all your chances!

[From [url=https://chocofrito.itch.io/i-dare-you-to-undress-rhoden]Itch.io[/url]]
